newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 4.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 4.

text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at Noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Tomorrow, the Prime Minister Mart Siimann and President Lennart Meri will discuss the appointment of a new minister for the vacant junior minister position of regional minister.
-Jaan Tammsalu has been appointed as the new dean of Viljandi county Lutheran deanship.
